claims.claim: Payments are loaded onto a prepaid card
claims.quote: You’ll get the payments on a prepaid card you can use in shops and online.
claims.note: The source specifies a prepaid card.

claims.claim: The card is topped up every four weeks
claims.quote: Your card is topped up every 4 weeks during pregnancy and whilst your children are under 3.
claims.note: The card page states the topping-up interval.

claims.claim: The card is for buying healthy food
claims.quote: Best Start Foods is a payment that can help you buy healthy foods like milk or fruit during pregnancy and when your child is under 3.
claims.note: The stated purpose is healthy foods.

claims.quote: £22.40 during pregnancy (you’ll get the same amount whether you’re having one or more babies)

claims.claim: The amount is £44.80 for each child under one
claims.quote: £44.80 for each child from birth until they’re one year old
claims.note: The source states this rate for each child from birth to age one.

claims.claim: The usual amount is £22.40 for each child aged one to under three
claims.quote: £22.40 for each child aged between one and 3 years old
claims.note: The source gives this usual age-based amount, with a separate premature-birth exception.

claims.claim: For a baby born early, the higher rate lasts until one year after the due date
claims.quote: If your baby’s born early, you’ll get the higher amount from birth until 1 year after the due date.
claims.note: The source states the premature-birth exception exactly.

claims.claim: Best Start Foods is available only to people living in Scotland
claims.note: The applicant or partner must meet the Scotland residence condition.

claims.claim: Applicants normally need a qualifying benefit or payment
claims.quote: To get Best Start Grant and Foods, normally you or your partner need to get one of these:
claims.note: The source states the normal qualifying-payment condition.

claims.claim: Applicants under 18 can qualify without a benefit
claims.quote: If you're under 18, you do not need to be on any payments or benefits to get Best Start Grant or Best Start Foods.

claims.claim: Some applicants aged 18 or 19 can qualify without their own benefit
claims.quote: If you're 18 or 19 and do not get any benefits or payments, you can still apply for Best Start Grant or Best Start Foods.
claims.note: The next sentence requires the parent or carer to receive a specified benefit.

claims.claim: Some families with no access to public funds can qualify without a qualifying benefit
claims.quote: You may be able to get Best Start Foods for your child even if you cannot get certain benefits because of your immigration status or because you do not have a status.
